products.title: 2 Wire RTD Pt1000 Surface Temperature Sensor with Self Adhesive Patch and with  10, 15 or 20ft Wire Leads
products.body_html:
2 Wire Pt1000 RTD Surface Temperature Sensor with Self Adhesive Patch with 10ft, 15ft, 20ft or 25ft Lead Wire
  • RTD Surface Temperature Sensor with a 1" long x 3/4" Wide x .010" Thick Polyimide Tape Fiberglass Reinforced Patch with Silicone Adhesive and Lead Wires.
  • Temperature Operating range is -90 to 500°F (-70 to 260°C)
  • Pt1000 (Platinum 1000 Ohm) 2-wire design with a highly accurate Class A RTD temperature sensing element encased in the self adhesive polyimide tape.
    • 1000 ohm design utilizes less current and minimizes self heating errors and provides longer life with battery powered applications 
  • Wire Leads - flexible 2 conductor wire with a 500°F (260°C) rated white PFA insulated jacket and stripped ends
  • Wire Construction - 26 gage stranded (7/34) nickel plated copper measuring .019" diameter each. The 2 wires have a .008" inch coating of PFA insulation and overall PFA jacket 
    • Color code is 1 Red and 1 Black with overall white jacket
    • Overall outside jacket is .080" inch diameter.
  • Design provides simple and fast surface mount with fast response and accurate temperature measurement.
    • Click for Spec Sheet to view print, or download the PDF file
    • EvoSensors Part Number: P2A-TAPE-REC-PK-1-PFXX-120-STWL - 10ft length wire leads

products.title: RTD Wire – 2 Wire Twisted Design 26 Gage Stranded with PFA Insulation
products.body_html:
RTD Wire – 2 Wire Twisted Design 26 Gage Stranded with PFA Insulation

  • Temperature Operating range up to 500°F (260°C)
  • Wire Construction is 2 bare 26 gage stranded (7/34 design - 7 strands of 34 gage) nickel plated copper wires with PFA insulationon each wire and twisted with an overall PFA  jacket. The overall outside cable diameter is a nominal .075" (1.9 mm).
  • Twisted Wire design provides an excellent combination of flexibility and strength, along with reducing the potential of electromagnetic interference (EMI) from electrical power generation and other devices.
  • PFA Insulation provides excellent resistance to abrasion, moisture, thermal aging and chemicals including solvents, acids, and oils. 
  • Color Coding with the 2 internal wire identified as 1 Red and 1 White with a White Overall jacket.
  • EvoSensors Part Number: U2X-PFXX-26S-TW (Enter number of feet)FT
    • Part Number Example: U2X-PFXX-26S-TW-100FT
